Added by hand, the "repinned" entry; every other character is still the 6ff9332 capture.

v217 added the attendance panel to index.html (#attendance-mount) and never re-captured this golden, so all three links had been red since that wave landed. MEASURED before adding: across all three links the ONLY difference from the 6ff9332 capture was this key - 1 added, 0 changed, 0 removed in the text map, and 0 changed in display apart from group-missing-note which this suite deletes explicitly. No existing sentence moved. The panel is written with mount.innerHTML (index.html:2658), so attendance.js correctly passes its DYNAMIC strings through attEscape: the count line is captured as "4 haven't answered", which renders as an apostrophe. Hard-coded button labels like Can't are raw because a literal apostrophe in element text needs no escaping. Both are correct; the capture records the markup as the page emits it, exactly as it already records the static LIVE MATCHES & PRESSES heading.

the attendance panel is GONE from the scorecard. It asked a golfer to Confirm or say Can't before tee time and measured 504x342 with sixteen buttons on a bare link of eight (319x342 with eight on a group link), directly above the hole view. This capture therefore loses exactly the three keys the v219 entry above ADDED, and nothing else: 3 removed, 0 added, 0 changed in the text map, and 0 changed in display. The panel's own words are the only thing that left any of the three links - verified by diffing this file against its pre-wave copy before writing it. The feature itself is untouched: attendance.js, the organizer's setup card, Round Ready and the Road Trip day line all still show and write the headcount, and attendance_test.js's other ten tests pass unchanged.

THE KP QUESTION was reworded and the select became one-tap name buttons. Across all three links this capture changes exactly TWO things, diffed before writing: 1 CHANGED key - kp-entry-mount, whose question line goes from "Did anyone in your group get inside it?" to "Did anyone get the KP in your group?". The two answers and everything else in the block are byte-identical. And 1 REMOVED key per link: "kp-pick-' + h + '". That key was never a real element. mini-dom registers an id when it scans id="..." out of static markup, index.html literally contained id="kp-pick-' + h + '" inside a JavaScript string, and the text captured for it was the neighbouring source, "' + opts + '". Wave 16 deleted that select, so the junk key goes with it - it is a harness artefact leaving, not a surface. TOTALS: 0 added, 1 changed, 3 removed across the three links; every filtered list identical; display unchanged but for group-missing-note, which this suite deletes explicitly.

THE "WHICH ONE ARE YOU?" QUESTION LEFT THE CARD and became one line inside My Round. Across all three links this capture changes exactly two things, diffed before writing: 1 REMOVED key - whoami-mount, whose text was "| Which one are you?|Ivy|Jon|Kim|Lee|Skip - just show everything|" - a 287px panel above score entry, measured cold at 390x844; and 1 CHANGED key - action-center-mount, which gains "| Which one are you?|choose|" directly after its header and is otherwise byte-identical. So the question did not disappear; it moved to the panel where four of the five behaviours it drives already appear. 0 added, 1 changed, 1 removed per link; every filtered list identical; display unchanged but for group-missing-note, which this suite deletes explicitly.

THE SCORECARD FOOTER BECAME ONE ROW: three full-width cards (Round Receipt, Save and Return to Home, How it works) at 342x166 each and 518px of footer became a 52px row - Save and exit filled, Receipt outline and only when the round has scores, the guide as a 60px icon - plus one grey line standing in for the Receipt before there are scores. THE TEXT MAP IS BYTE-IDENTICAL: 0 added, 0 changed, 0 removed on all three links. The cards were static markup and never entered this capture, and neither does the row. The only change is ONE ADDED display key per link, sc-foot-note, because renderFooterRow sets the display on that line every snapshot - shown while the round has no scores, hidden once the Receipt is there. Diffed before writing.

UI Wave 24 - Net Finish names nobody until the round is finished. DIFFED BEFORE RE-CAPTURING: across the three links, 0 added, 2 CHANGED and 0 removed. Both changes are the same key, action-center-mount, on the two links whose round is unfinished (group-3 and bare); one-group-1 is byte-identical because its round is finished and the finished view did not move. The change is exactly two things going and two arriving: the summary line loses "leads net" and the block loses "PROJECTED" and its named rows, replaced by the pot, the split "1st $60 - 2nd $40" and the line "Winners show once every card is in." No filtered list changed, and display is unchanged but for group-missing-note, which this suite deletes explicitly.

Wave 27b - the header subtitle and the Playing With card now give ONE answer, from roundScoringBasis(). DIFFED BEFORE RE-CAPTURING: across the three links, 0 added, 3 CHANGED and 0 removed. All three are the same key, format-subtitle, and the same change: "Scope - STROKE (NET)" became "Scope - STROKE PLAY (NET)". The header now uses the cards label vocabulary (MAIN_GAME_LABELS) instead of the raw stored key, so a plain stroke round reads STROKE PLAY. Nothing else moved on any link, no filtered list changed, and display is unchanged but for group-missing-note which this suite deletes explicitly.

Wave 39 - THREE WAYS INTO A ROUND. The arrival sheet asked one question (which group are you keeping score for) and offered Just watching as the way out; it missed the most common answer, a golfer who is PLAYING and not keeping score. DIFFED BEFORE RE-CAPTURING: across the three links, 1 text key CHANGED, 0 added, 0 removed, and 1 DISPLAY key added. The changed key is group-pick-body on the bare link only - the rows now read 'Keep score for Group N' with the names on a second line, plus the two new rows. The added display key is role-note, 'none' on all three links, handled the way card-is-in was in Wave 36: asserted 'none' then deleted, so if it ever RENDERS on one of these links that is a real change and the assertion is where it shows up. AND THE DIFF CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT: the first version showed 'Just watching.' on the bare link while the sheet was still up asking how the golfer was joining - an answer to a question on screen. roundRoleOf() defaults to watching because a bare link grants nothing, which is right for permissions and wrong as a sentence; the note now speaks only for a role the golfer chose.
